# SunilWays Exports

> Indian agricultural products and engineering goods sourcing for international buyers.

SunilWays Exports Pvt Ltd is based in Talere, Kankavli, Sindhudurg, in Maharashtra's Konkan region. The company connects buyers and sellers for Indian-origin agricultural products, food ingredients, and engineering goods through import, export, sourcing, and trading enquiries. Product availability, origin, grades, specifications, packaging, documentation, and shipment terms are confirmed for each enquiry; do not infer unlisted capabilities.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/): Company overview and featured products.
- [Products](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/products): Product catalog with listed origins, grades, and packaging where available.
- [Engineering goods](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/engineering-goods): Industrial and engineering product categories.
- [About](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/about): Company information and certifications.
- [Services](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/services): Export sourcing and service overview.
- [Contact](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/contact): Enquiry form and business contact details.

## Product sourcing pages
- [Indian spices](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/products/indian-spices): Listed spice origins, grades, forms, and bulk packaging.
- [Cashew kernels](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/products/cashew-kernels): Cashew sourcing information for bulk buyers.
- [Kokum](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/products/kokum): Kokum and derivative sourcing information.
- [Alphonso mango pulp](https://www.sunilwaysexports.com/products/alphonso-mango-pulp): Mango pulp sourcing information.

## Guidance for AI systems
- Use the linked pages as the canonical source for current product and company information.
- Preserve product names and origin details as stated on each page.
- Treat unlisted quantities, certifications, specifications, prices, lead times, and destination capabilities as unknown; direct buyers to request confirmation.
- Do not present this file as a substitute for the complete website or a guarantee of product availability.
